summary: LED Billboard Order Flow Bug Fix Verified - All features working correctly. Backend API accepts 'led_billboard' listing_type and treats it as platform-managed. Frontend cart and PlaceOrderPage correctly handle LED billboard packages with proper field mapping.
seed_data_creation: Used existing LED billboard packages (Kano state, Zoo road, 40ft by 12ft)
context_for_next_testing_agent: LED Billboard order flow is fully functional. The fix correctly handles: 1) Cart item field mapping (listingType, influencerId for compatibility), 2) PlaceOrderPage uses item.listingId || item.influencerId and item.listingType || item.type, 3) Backend accepts 'led_billboard' as valid listing_type and treats it as platform-managed (supplier_id='lightban-platform').

Backend_LED_Packages_API.description: GET /api/led-billboard/packages with filters returns matching packages

Backend_LED_Order_Creation.description: POST /api/orders with listing_type='led_billboard' creates order successfully with supplier_id='lightban-platform'

Backend_Order_Persistence.description: Created LED billboard orders can be retrieved via GET /api/orders/{id}

Backend_Order_In_User_List.description: LED billboard orders appear in user's order list via GET /api/orders

Backend_Order_Without_Package_Price.description: Order creation works when package_price is not provided (calculates from total)

Backend_Cash_Payment_Order.description: LED billboard order with payment_method='cash' sets payment_status='pending_cash'

Frontend_LED_Modal_Opens.description: Clicking 'View Packages & Book' on LED Billboard opens LED Selection modal

Frontend_Cascading_Dropdowns.description: State, Road, Size dropdowns work correctly with cascading selection

Frontend_View_Packages.description: View Packages button loads packages for selected state/road/size

Frontend_Add_To_Cart.description: Add to Cart button adds LED package with correct field mapping (listingType, influencerId)

Frontend_Cart_Display.description: Cart displays LED billboard package correctly

Frontend_Place_Order_Page.description: PlaceOrderPage accepts LED billboard packages and shows correct pricing

Frontend_Order_Creation.description: Order is created successfully with listing_type='led_billboard'

Frontend_Order_Completion.description: Order completes successfully with confirmation toast

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: LED billboard packages can be added to cart but cannot proceed to place order
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Cart item had different field names than what PlaceOrderPage expected, and backend didn't recognize 'led_billboard' as valid listing type

fix_applied.BillboardsPage.js: Updated handleAddToCart to include listingType, influencerId for compatibility
fix_applied.PlaceOrderPage.js: Updated to use item.listingId || item.influencerId and item.listingType || item.type
fix_applied.server.py: Updated create_order to handle 'led_billboard' listing_type as platform-managed

bug_fix_verification.verification_result: PASS - Full E2E flow works correctly
